scope: Connect DROP INDEX publication to the fixed SQLite index namespace and transient catalog.

src/Model/Statement/Declaration/Index.ph.role: Absolute catalog schema, name and owner.

src/Model/Contract/AnalysisContext.php.role: Immutable index collection and closed owner lookup in an exact schema.

src/Model/Contract/SearchPath.php.role: Explicit attachment order, including the empty decoded schema name.

src/Model/Facade/Catalog.php.role: Collect and retain each application-defined index identity from its bound SQL declaration.

src/Platform.php.role: Export the bound owner and carry indexes in their fixed declaration context.

src/Statement/Schema/Drop.php.role: Identify the separate index case in the typed grammar.

src/Lowering/Definition/SchemaRule.php.role: Match the SQLite grammar production and preserve exact name and guard.
